# ship


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

A thin Mac app is kavacha’s launcher, the pinned uv, a signed bootstrap
lock and three generated files, in one bundle. This module puts them
together, signs the helper and then the app, notarizes and staples it,
zips it, uploads it to the release `app-v<V>` and writes the Homebrew
cask. The launcher is a kavacha release (`Thin.launcher`, checked
against `Thin.launcher_sha256`), or a local build of `swift/` for a
test.

### The pieces

[`fetch_uv`](https://vedicreader.github.io/kavacha/ship.html#fetch_uv)
downloads the pinned uv and checks it against the pinned sha256 before
it unpacks it.

### The bundle

[`bundle`](https://vedicreader.github.io/kavacha/ship.html#bundle) lays
out the app as `contract/api-1.md` names it. An app’s `plist()` hook
adds to the Info.plist, such as document types the app computes. It
moves an old bundle aside, never into the trash of the person’s Mac.

``` python

test_eq(('version "1.0.0"' in c, 'sha256 "ab"' in c, 'uninstall quit: "org.demo.demo"' in c), (True, True, True))
```

### The flow

[`build_mac`](https://vedicreader.github.io/kavacha/ship.html#build_mac)
builds and signs a bundle and checks it with `verify_app`.
[`ship_mac`](https://vedicreader.github.io/kavacha/ship.html#ship_mac)
is the release: it refuses a dirty tree, a dev lock or a missing
Developer ID; then it notarizes, staples, zips, uploads to `app-v<V>`
with `--latest=false`, and writes the cask. Notary credentials are a
keychain profile (`--profile`) or an App Store Connect key.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<a

### staple

``` python
def staple(
    app, tries:int=6, wait:int=20
):
```

*Staple Apple’s ticket to `app` and check it. Apple’s ticket service can
lag the verdict by a minute, so a failure is tried again before it stops
the release.*

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<a
href="https://github.com/vedicreader/kavacha/blob/main/kavacha/ship.py#L132"
target="_blank" style="float:right; font-size:smaller">source</a>

### notarize

``` python
def notarize(
    nz, notary
):
```

*Submit `nz`, wait for Apple’s verdict, and stop with Apple’s own log
unless it is Accepted; the submission id. `notarytool --wait` can exit 0
on a rejection, so the status is read, not the exit code.*

`--release V` is the release flow.
